in_arabic.name: نَزْهَات
in_arabic.meaning: النزهة والتنزه في الجنة أو في الحياة
in_arabic.long_meaning: نَزْهَات مشتقة من النزاهة والنزهة، تعني التنزه في الجنة أو في الحياة، ويشير إلى السعادة والراحة والبعد عن كل مكروه أو سوء، كما ورد في القرآن الكريم في سياق الحديث عن الجنة والخلد فيها.

in_urdu.name: نزہات
in_urdu.meaning: جنت میں سیر کرنا یا زندگی میں خوش رہنا
in_urdu.long_meaning: نزہات کا مطلب ہے جنت میں سیر کرنا یا زندگی میں خوش رہنا، یہ نام عربی جڑوں سے ماخوذ ہے اور اسلامی روایت میں اس کا استعمال شادابی اور خوشحالی کے معنی میں ہوتا ہے، خاص طور پر جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان۔

in_english.name: Nazhaat
in_english.meaning: To stroll in Paradise or to enjoy life
in_english.long_meaning: Nazhaat originates from Arabic roots, specifically from 'nazaha,' meaning to stroll or walk in a pleasant place. In Islamic tradition, it connotes strolling in Paradise or enjoying life's pleasures. The name suggests a serene and joyful existence, reflecting values of happiness and spiritual fulfillment across Muslim cultures.

data.cultural_impact: The name Nazhaat is a beautiful and unique name in Islamic culture. It signifies a person who brings joy and delight to those around them. In Islamic society, the importance of joy and happiness is deeply ingrained, as it is considered a blessing from Allah (SWT). The name Nazhaat, therefore, represents someone who embodies this important aspect of life and brings joy and positivity to those around them.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Nazhaat is rooted in the idea of spreading joy and happiness as a means of bringing people closer to Allah (SWT). In the Quran, Allah (SWT) says, "And Allah has imposed on none except [belief] in Allah and [the fulfillment of] righteousness from what He has brought them. And there is diverse reward for them according to what they did." (18:54) The name Nazhaat, then, can be seen as a reminder to spread joy and happiness as a form of righteousness and a means of drawing closer to Allah (SWT). It can also be a reminder to seek joy and happiness in the remembrance and worship of Allah (SWT) and to recognize that true joy and happiness come from within, through a deep connection to the Divine.
